baseItems.name: Lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) house battery, 200Ah
baseItems.whatItIs: A 200Ah lithium iron phosphate battery that stores the power for everything in the van.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Runs the fridge, lights, fan and outlets for a day or more off the grid, and lasts thousands of charge cycles.

baseItems.name: 2000W pure sine wave inverter/charger
baseItems.whatItIs: A 2,000-watt pure sine wave inverter that turns battery power into household 110V, with a built-in charger for shore power.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Lets you run a laptop, a coffee maker or a hair dryer from the battery, and recharges it whenever you plug in.

baseItems.name: 50A DC-DC battery charger with built-in MPPT solar charger
baseItems.whatItIs: Charges the house batteries from the van's alternator while you drive, at up to 50 amps.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: A few hours on the road refills the batteries even on a cloudy day, without draining the van's own starting battery.

baseItems.name: Battery monitor with shunt
baseItems.whatItIs: A battery monitor with a shunt that measures every amp going in and out.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Shows exactly how much power you have left, so you never guess and never run the battery flat.

baseItems.name: 12V fuse block and DC breakers
baseItems.whatItIs: The 12V fuse block and DC breakers every circuit in the van runs through.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Protects the wiring and every device on it, and makes any circuit easy to switch off or trace.

baseItems.name: Main battery disconnect switch
baseItems.whatItIs: A main switch that disconnects the house battery from everything.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: One turn shuts the whole system down for storage, service or an emergency.

baseItems.name: Wiring, cable, fusing and connectors (lot)
baseItems.whatItIs: All the cable, fuses, terminals and connectors that wire the van, sized and labeled.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Correctly sized, protected wiring is what keeps a van electrical system safe for years.

baseItems.name: 110V outlet with USB-A and USB-C
baseItems.whatItIs: Four 110-volt outlets with USB-A and USB-C ports, plus dedicated outlets for the induction cooktop and the microwave.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Charge phones and laptops where you actually use them, with no extension cords across the counter.

baseItems.name: 110V GFCI outlet
baseItems.whatItIs: A 110-volt outlet with ground fault protection, and a second one in the equipment compartment.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: It cuts the power in a fraction of a second if water and electricity meet, which matters in a van with a sink and a shower.

baseItems.name: 30A shore power inlet and 25' cord
baseItems.whatItIs: An outside plug for campground or driveway power, rated at 30 amps.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Plug in at a campsite or at home and the whole van runs on grid power while the batteries charge.

baseItems.name: 110V AC breaker panel
baseItems.whatItIs: A 110V breaker panel for the household outlets.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Each 110V circuit is protected and can be switched off on its own, the same as in a house.

baseItems.name: LED strip ceiling lights with lens cover, two full-length runs, dimmable
baseItems.whatItIs: Two lens-covered LED strips running the length of the ceiling, recessed into the slats.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Even light from end to end with no fixtures to bump your head on.

baseItems.name: 200W rooftop solar
baseItems.whatItIs: Roof-mounted solar panels rated at 200 watts, sized to the roof on the shorter van.
baseItems.whyYouNeedIt: Every sunny hour tops the batteries back up, so you can stay parked off-grid for days instead of hunting for a plug.

baseItems.name: 12V water pump with accumulator

baseItems.name: Inline water filter

upgrades.whatItIs: The Advanced interior light package.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Brighter, more flexible lighting throughout the cabin.

upgrades.name: Advanced exterior light package: light bar and perimeter lights
upgrades.whatItIs: The Advanced exterior light package: a light bar and perimeter lights.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Lights up the road and the whole campsite.

upgrades.name: Wheels and tires package: 5 all-terrain wheels and tires
upgrades.whatItIs: Five all-terrain wheels and tires, spare included.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Grip on dirt, gravel and snow, and a matching spare for when a trail bites back.

upgrades.name: Window cover package
upgrades.whatItIs: Van Essentials window covers for every window.
upgrades.whyYouNeedIt: Privacy, shade and insulation at night or in the sun.

BD01.whatItIs: A fixed bed that's always made, with garage storage underneath.
BD01.whyYouNeedIt: No setting up or packing away at night, and room under the bed for the gear you use every day.

BD02.whyYouNeedIt: More room to stretch out, with the big gear stowed below.

BD03.whatItIs: A fixed bed plus a two-seat nook and table by the window.
BD03.whyYouNeedIt: A place to sit for coffee, maps or work without making up the bed.

BD04.whatItIs: A dinette with facing benches and a table that converts into the bed.
BD04.whyYouNeedIt: Eat and hang out at a real table, then make it the bed at night. The whole van works as one room.

BD05.whatItIs: An electric lift bed that rises to the ceiling over the dinette.
BD05.whyYouNeedIt: Dinner at the table, then bring the bed down; the living room stays set up underneath.

BC01.whatItIs: An open panel across the front of the bed.
BC01.whyYouNeedIt: Closes off the bed frame with easy reach into the space below.

BC02.whatItIs: A panel across the front of the bed with a door.
BC02.whyYouNeedIt: Closes off the bed frame and turns the space below into a cabinet you reach from inside.

SC01.whatItIs: A pair of reading lights above the bed.
SC01.whyYouNeedIt: Read in bed without lighting up the whole van.

OC01.whatItIs: Soft-sided overhead cabinets above the bed, driver side.
OC01.whyYouNeedIt: Storage for clothes and light gear right where you sleep.

SS01.whatItIs: A slide-out tray in the rear garage that pulls out the back doors. Two trays side by side.
SS01.whyYouNeedIt: Reach heavy gear at the back of the garage without climbing in.

SHN.whatItIs: A tall cabinet where the shower would go.
SHN.whyYouNeedIt: More storage and a longer bench if you shower outside or at campgrounds.

SHY.whatItIs: An enclosed indoor shower with a toilet, hot and cold water.
SHY.whyYouNeedIt: A hot shower and a private bathroom inside the van, whatever the weather.

LRSH01.whatItIs: The living room that fits beside the shower: a bench seat, fold-out table and an under-counter fridge.
LRSH01.whyYouNeedIt: A place to sit and eat, with the fridge tucked away under the counter.

LRSH02.whatItIs: The living room beside the shower with a tall fridge.
LRSH02.whyYouNeedIt: A bigger fridge for longer trips away from a store.

LRNSH01.whatItIs: The living room without a shower: a longer bench, fold-out table and an under-counter fridge.
LRNSH01.whyYouNeedIt: More seating where the shower would be.

LRNSH02.whatItIs: The living room without a shower, with the tall fridge.
LRNSH02.whyYouNeedIt: More seating and a bigger fridge.

OHS1.whatItIs: A shelf over the driver and passenger seats, in the headliner.
OHS1.whyYouNeedIt: Uses the space over the cab for jackets, hats and small gear.

PK01.whatItIs: The full kitchenette counter with the sink. The insert you pick fits under it.
PK01.whyYouNeedIt: Every Papago van gets a real kitchen: counter space, a sink and storage.

FT01.whatItIs: A table hinged to the end of the counter that folds out when you need it.
FT01.whyYouNeedIt: Extra counter or table space that folds away when you don't.

PI02.whatItIs: A double-door cupboard under the counter.
PI02.whyYouNeedIt: Open storage for pots, pans and bigger items.

PI01.whatItIs: Three drawers and a door under the counter.
PI01.whyYouNeedIt: Drawers keep utensils and small things organized and easy to reach.

PU02.whatItIs: Overhead cabinets above the kitchen, all storage.
PU02.whyYouNeedIt: The most cabinet space above the counter.

PU01.whatItIs: Overhead cabinets above the kitchen with a built-in 700W microwave.
PU01.whyYouNeedIt: Reheat and cook quickly without a second appliance on the counter.

ST01.whatItIs: A two-burner induction cooktop set into the counter, in place of the single burner.
ST01.whyYouNeedIt: Cook two things at once, on battery power.

CB01.whatItIs: A cutting board that fits over the sink.
CB01.whyYouNeedIt: Adds counter space when you need it and covers the sink when you don't.
